test_concat_series: test concatenating pandas Series with pyarrow and python StringDtype storage backends and NA values
test_concat_with_object: test concatenating a StringDtype Series with an object dtype Series results in object dtype
test_concat_with_numpy: test find_common_type between StringDtype and various numpy dtypes including U, S, int64, and StringDType
test_pyarrow_preference: test that pyarrow StringDtype is preferred over python StringDtype when concatenating mixed storage types
test_na_value_preference: test that pd.NA is preferred over np.nan as the na_value when concatenating python StringDtype Series
